title: DeepAVR: Deep Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Vulnerability Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.32345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has emerged as a critical defense against software security flaws, aiming to triage and fix bugs autonomously. Early LLM-based approaches focused on patch generation under the assumption of perfect fault localization, while recent end-to-end methods attempt to repair vulnerabilities directly from sanitizer logs. However, these methods often fail when the root cause is deeply hidden--either physically distant from the crash site or logically masked by interdependent errors--making the initial report insufficient. We propose DeepAVR, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end AVR that performs deep analysis by transforming intermediate repair outcomes into structured diagnostic feedback. translated_title: DeepAVR：基于多智能体协作的自动化漏洞修复深度分析方法
translated_abstract: 自动化漏洞修复（AVR）已成为抵御软件安全缺陷的关键防线，旨在自主地对漏洞进行分诊与修复。早期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法在假定故障定位完美无缺的前提下专注于补丁生成，而近期的端到端方法则尝试直接依据消毒器日志来修复漏洞。然而，当根本原因被深深隐藏时——无论是物理上远离崩溃点，还是在逻辑上被相互关联的错误所掩盖——这些方法往往会失败，因为初始报告提供的信息并不充分。我们提出了DeepAVR，一个用于端到端自动化漏洞修复的多智能体框架，它通过将中间修复结果转化为结构化的诊断反馈来执行深度分析。DeepAVR将修复过程分解为专门的智能体角色——故障定位、补丁生成、编译验证、安全验证、功能验证和补丁审查——并在这些角色之间传递反馈以进行迭代……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: DeepAVR提出了一种多智能体协作框架，将中间修复结果转化为结构化诊断反馈，并在故障定位、补丁生成、编译/安全/功能验证与补丁审查等专门角色之间流转反馈，从而实现端到端的深度漏洞分析与自动化修复。
en_tdlr: DeepAVR is a multi-agent framework for end-to-end automated vulnerability repair that performs deep analysis by transforming intermediate repair outcomes into structured diagnostic feedback routed across specialized roles, including fault localization, patch generation, compile/security/functionality validation, and patch review.
